assets.prompt: A small clear glass dish holding a pale, faintly opalescent viscous serum liquid, shot from a slight overhead angle (not flat top-down) so the glass rim and dish depth are visible. A thin, glossy stream of the same liquid falls into the dish from just above the frame, creating soft ripples on the surface. Professional flat-lay product photograph, 1:1 square format, single subject centered with generous negative space on all sides. Background: warm off-white cream matte seamless paper with subtle visible grain texture, no props, no gradient, no color block. Lighting: soft diffused single-direction light casting one soft-edged low-contrast shadow, no specular hotspots, no visible light source, no hard vignette. No text, no logo, no watermark, no human hand or body part.
assets.depicted_as: glass dish of pale opalescent viscous serum with a pouring stream
assets.notes: Depicts PDRN as a purified biopolymer solution (no natural raw form of its own), matching this folder's own established convention for such ingredients.
